name: Sparse Texture Binding
aliases: Hardware-managed page tables for sparse volumes
definition: A lossless hardware-level solution in modern graphics APIs (Vulkan, Direct3D 12) that decouples virtual volume size from physical memory footprint using hardware-managed page tables.
summary: Sparse Texture Binding is a hardware-managed mechanism that decouples virtual volume size from physical memory by allocating pages only for active subregions, unlike software-based virtual page tables.
